guarantees.claim: prng_seed_en is forced to 0 when SecSkipPRNGReseeding is true; otherwise it equals reseed_req_i.
reseed_ack_o is driven by reseed_req_i when SecSkipPRNGReseeding is true; otherwise by prng_seed_done.

assumptions.claim: When SecSkipPRNGReseeding is false, prng_seed_done must be asserted only in response to a prior assertion of prng_seed_en (i.e., a valid reseed completion handshake).
assumptions.risk: If prng_seed_done is spuriously high without prior prng_seed_en, reseed_ack_o may be asserted early, allowing downstream logic to use a PRNG that is not properly seeded, weakening cryptographic masking.

uncertain_points.claim: The assignment to unused_prng_seed_done is inside a block (ended at line 81) whose generate condition is not shown; the signal may be undriven in certain configurations.
uncertain_points.risk: Synthesis may issue warnings or infer latches if the signal is undriven, and downstream unused warning suppression may fail.

uncertain_points.claim: The SecSkipPRNGReseeding parameter, when true, forces prng_seed_en to 0 and bypasses the reseed handshake (reseed_ack_o = reseed_req_i). It is unclear whether this mode is secure and under what circumstances PRNG reseeding can be safely skipped, risking weak masking entropy.
uncertain_points.risk: Masking strength depends on fresh PRNG output. Skipping reseeding may lead to predictable mask values, compromising SCA resistance and AES key extraction.
